title: THE KILL FEED STARTS UNDER CONDITIONS
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-08, in v19.07: the co-op kill feed started at 46 percent of the screen height, which clears a normal CONDITIONS panel, but a panel grown with its grip, dragged down or long with contracts reached past that, and each kill printed over its rows for six seconds. The feed now starts under the panel whenever the panel is in its column.
now: In co-op the kill feed never prints over the CONDITIONS panel.

edits.anchor: ctx.save(); ctx.scale(_fhr,_fhr); y=Math.round(H*0.46/_fhr); x=(W-LH(16)*_fhr)/_fhr;   // v19.07: below CONDITIONS (was 0.40, which a long contract list reaches)
